b003bfc4dbe6290f.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking a Physicist & Radiation Safety Officer to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves assessing and ensuring the quality and continuity of the radiation protection program within Fakeeh Health Care facilities. The officer will also be responsible for sharing program information with staff and ensuring their compliance with established parameters. Key Responsibilities Liaise with the Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) for new facility requirements and act as a contact between regulatory agencies and the licensee. Establish and implement radiation safety policies and procedures in accordance with care standards and local authorities. Develop and maintain a generic radiation protection program aligned with national and international standards. Conduct regular assessments and updates of the radiation safety program. Perform periodic inspections to ensure compliance with SFDA, Ministry of Interior, and other national/international radiation protection requirements. Instruct staff operating radiological equipment on appropriate radiation safety practices. Ensure the availability of radiation survey devices and supplies, perform quality tests, and arrange for calibration. Maintain radiation survey records, including incident reports and corrective actions. Manage personal radiation dosimeter badges, collect and redistribute them, and explain their usage and readings to radiation workers. Investigate cases of workers or patients exceeding radiation dose limits and implement corrective actions. Oversee and implement operational aspects of the radiation protection program, including stopping unsafe procedures. Stay updated on new aspects of radiation safety and participate in continuing education. Educate patients and their families on radiation safety procedures. Oversee the ordering, labeling, management, and disposal of radioactive materials, maintaining accurate inventory and records. Test and evaluate lead aprons, assigning individual identification numbers. Perform quality control on nuclear medicine devices, monitor radiation exposure in the nuclear medicine unit, and evaluate radiation exposure from radioactive materials. Oversee procedures for radioactive iodine (I-131) therapy patients, including safety instructions, dose preparation, and isolation unit management. Perform nuclear medicine duties as required and respond to staff inquiries regarding radiation safety policies. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. Specific educational qualifications were not provided but are expected to align with the technical demands of a Physicist and Radiation Safety Officer role. Fakeeh Care Employee Responsibilities Perform all duties in support of Fakeeh’s Person-Centered care values. Actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Adhere to safety protocols and proactively address job-related safety concerns. Maintain strict confidentiality of all sensitive information. Comply with cybersecurity policies and standards, participating in awareness training. Uphold Fakeeh Care’s code of conduct, policies, and ethical standards. Complete mandatory education requirements prior to expiration. Work Type This is a full-time position within the Fakeeh Care Group. Application Information Salary details for this position are not disclosed. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

b0482a13747ac62c.job_title: Manager Operational Readiness Planning and Reporting DA

The Role of Health Educator My Clinic KSA is seeking a Health Educator to join its team in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves providing clinical advice and education to individuals living with, or at risk of developing, diabetes. The Health Educator will support patients in making necessary lifestyle changes related to diabetes management, including aspects of nutrition, medication, physical activity, and glucose testing, to help them overcome challenges and lead healthier lives. Key Responsibilities Assist individuals with diabetes, their families, and caregivers in acquiring the knowledge, skills, motivation, and confidence required for condition management. Educate patients on diabetes, including potential complications and its relationship to other health conditions. Offer guidance and support regarding lifestyle modifications that aid in diabetes management. Provide instruction on medication management safety, covering actions, timing, and side effects, as well as insulin therapy use (*, correct injection technique, checking injection sites). Deliver education on self-monitoring of blood glucose levels, including technique and interpretation of results. Support patients in setting health goals and implementing strategies to achieve them. Encourage collaboration among various healthcare providers involved in the diabetes care team, such as general practitioners, specialist medical practitioners (endocrinologists/diabetologists), dietitians, physiotherapists, podiatrists, optometrists, and pharmacists. Introduce, educate on, demonstrate, and install Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) devices and other devices like insulin pumps for patients on multiple daily insulin injections, aiming for significant improvement in quality of life. b0ccb18f6927c682.description: About the Role Sheraton is seeking a Duty Technician to join their team. b0eb4dd586057ac0.description: About Mozn MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence. We’re a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact. If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises. About the role You will be the operational owner for production health of our financial crime intelligence platform: data pipelines (ETL/ELT) and the FCI backend services (APIs, graph/network services and databases). You monitor, triage, diagnose and fix incidents, keep scheduled pipelines running, and turn recurring issues into permanent fixes, runbooks and monitoring. You work directly with fraud investigators, analysts and the customer's IT/operations teams. What you'll do Monitor daily data pipeline runs (Python/Polars/Pandas scripts, Airflow DAGs, scheduled jobs); detect failures, delays and data-quality problems before users do. Triage and resolve production incidents: read logs, reproduce with sample data, find root cause (schema/dtype drift, corrupt or empty files, upstream delays, memory pressure, SQL errors) and apply or propose a tested fix. Support platform backend (FastAPI services, graph/network API, PostgreSQL, Oracle sources): investigate slow or failing API calls, 5xx errors, memory growth and pod restarts using application logs, request traces and container metrics. Run, re-run and back-fill pipelines safely (full vs incremental loads, dry-run modes, catch-up of missed days) and verify the output. Execute and validate database changes and migrations in UAT and production following the change process, with rollback steps. Operate in containerized environments (OpenShift/Kubernetes, Docker): check pod health, resource limits, environment settings, rollouts and logs using CLI tools, within namespace-level access. Own incident communication: clear status updates, impact assessment and post-incident summaries for business and technical audiences. Write and maintain runbooks, known-error lists and operational checklists; automate repetitive checks and alerts. Reduce alert noise and tune alerting; make sure manual re-runs do not trigger duplicate customer-facing alerts. Work with data engineers and developers to hand over defects with reproducible evidence, and to validate fixes through UAT before release. Support onboarding of new data sources and data requests where operations are involved. Follow security and data-handling rules: least-privilege access, no sensitive data in tickets or logs, approved change windows. Requirements 5+ years of experience in data engineering, production support, or a similar operations-focused technical role Strong Python skills for ETL development and debugging (Pandas and/or Polars; reading stack traces and fixing data type, schema and null-handling issues) Strong SQL skills (PostgreSQL and/or Oracle): complex queries, query plans, partitioned tables, running and validating migrations Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, including scheduling, incremental vs full loads, back-fills and failure recovery Solid understanding of dimensional modeling (star schema, fact and dimension tables) and file formats such as Parquet Experience consuming and troubleshooting RESTful APIs (status codes, latency, authentication, timeouts) Working knowledge of Linux command line, log analysis (grep, jq, tail) and shell scripting Working experience with Docker and containers; basic Kubernetes/OpenShift operations (oc/kubectl: logs, describe, rollout, resource limits) Structured incident handling: prioritisation, root-cause analysis, documentation Strong client-facing and written/verbal communication skills; comfortable explaining technical issues to non-technical users Nice to have Experience with Apache Airflow or other workflow orchestration Knowledge of backend system and basic API development; understanding of OpenTelemetry-style tracing and structured JSON logs Experience with diagnosing memory or performance issues in Python services Experience with Git and a code review/release workflow; ability to submit small, tested fixes Exposure to graph analysis, fraud, AML or banking data and the investigation workflow Familiarity with monitoring and dashboard tools (Grafana, Prometheus) Exposure to PySpark, message queues or streaming platforms (Kafka, IBMQ) Understanding of data quality frameworks and governance practices Experience with ITSM tooling (ServiceNow, Jira) and SLAs Willingness to join an on-call rota for critical production incidents Benefits You will be at the forefront of an exciting time for the Middle East, joining a high-growth rocket-ship in an exciting space. You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best. The fundamentals will be taken care of: competitive compensation, top-tier health insurance, and an enabling culture so that you can focus on what you do best You will enjoy a fun and dynamic workplace working alongside some of the greatest minds in AI. We believe strength lies in difference, embracing all for who they are and empowered to be the best version of themselves.

b0bfeec80f34bef2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أوريون آدفايزوري عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع، بالإضافة إلى متابعة التحصيلات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات التي تقدمها الشركة. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمحتملين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لتقديم عروض البيع وترويج المنتجات، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، وتوريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المندوب ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي لدعم أهداف الشركة وتحقيق النمو. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

b0007b0a1f3fe60e.description: The Senior Systems Engineer – Enterprise Services is responsible for the administration, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise IT infrastructure and Microsoft-based technology solutions across ZainTECH's customer environments. The role ensures the availability, performance, security, and reliability of critical infrastructure services while providing advanced technical support and maintaining operational standards in accordance with customer requirements and industry best practices. Working closely with customers, technical delivery teams, Project Managers, and other infrastructure specialists, the Senior Systems Engineer supports the full lifecycle of enterprise infrastructure solutions, including deployment, configuration, migration, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance. The role also contributes to infrastructure improvements, technical documentation, and knowledge transfer to ensure effective service delivery and long-term operational stability. Responsibilities: Enterprise Infrastructure Administration & Operations Administer, maintain, and support enterprise IT infrastructure and Microsoft-based systems across customer environments. Perform daily, weekly, and monthly operational activities to ensure the availability, performance, and reliability of critical infrastructure services. Monitor system health, capacity, and performance, proactively identifying and addressing potential operational issues. Implement and maintain system configurations, security controls, and operational procedures in accordance with established best practices. Support the administration of enterprise infrastructure services, ensuring secure and reliable access for authorized users. Perform preventive maintenance, system updates, and routine operational checks to minimize service disruptions. Technical Support & Troubleshooting Provide advanced technical support to enterprise customers through on-site and remote troubleshooting. Investigate, diagnose, and resolve infrastructure incidents, system failures, and performance-related issues. Support major customer accounts through proactive technical engagement, issue resolution, and ongoing service improvement. Troubleshoot Microsoft infrastructure technologies, including Active Directory, Exchange Server, Microsoft 365, virtualization, and cloud services. Escalate complex technical issues to relevant specialists or vendors where required, ensuring appropriate follow-up and resolution. Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to customer IT teams to support effective system administration and operational continuity. Infrastructure Implementation & Migration Install, configure, deploy, and integrate enterprise infrastructure solutions in accordance with approved technical designs and customer requirements. Implement Microsoft infrastructure technologies, including identity services, messaging platforms, virtualization, and cloud-based solutions. Support and supervise infrastructure migrations, upgrades, and system modernization activities while minimizing disruption to customer operations. Configure and optimize infrastructure environments to meet performance, availability, and security requirements. Coordinate implementation activities with Project Managers, technical teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful delivery. Validate infrastructure configurations and ensure deployed solutions meet agreed technical specifications and operational requirements. Microsoft Cloud & Enterprise Services Administer and support Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services, identity management, authentication, and access control solutions. Support Microsoft Exchange Server and Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and associated collaboration technologies. Configure and maintain Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization environments and related infrastructure services. Support Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), Azure AD Connect, Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS), and Privileged Identity Management (PIM). Administer Microsoft Azure infrastructure services, including virtual machines, virtual networks, storage accounts, and related cloud resources. Support Microsoft Intune, information protection, and enterprise mobility and security capabilities. Implement and maintain monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery solutions using Microsoft Azure and associated technologies. Testing, Documentation & Reporting Perform system integration testing, configuration validation, and operational readiness assessments for implemented solutions. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, implementation records, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides. Document infrastructure changes, upgrades, and maintenance activities to ensure accurate technical records. Provide regular technical status updates and progress reports to Project Managers, supervisors, and relevant stakeholders. Communicate incidents, technical risks, and operational issues clearly, escalating matters requiring management attention. Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance infrastructure performance, security, and service delivery quality. Our Culture & Code of Conduct: At ZainTECH, we take pride in a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and uncompromising integrity. We are looking for individuals who share these values and are committed to customer-centricity and ethical excellence. All employees are expected to uphold our Code of Conduct, which serves as a guiding framework for responsible behavior across everything we do — from ho we work with each other to how we engage with clients and partners globally. Experience & Qualifications 4–6 years of experience in Microsoft infrastructure administration, enterprise systems engineering, or related IT infrastructure roles. Hands-on experience administering and supporting Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services, including user management, authentication, and directory services. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Exchange Server and Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and related collaboration platforms. Experience with Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization technologies. Working knowledge of Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS) and hybrid identity environments. Experience configuring and supporting Microsoft SQL Server infrastructure. Familiarity with Microsoft System Center products and enterprise infrastructure management technologies. Hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Azure services, including: Azure Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS): Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts, and related infrastructure services. Identity & Access Management: Microsoft Entra ID, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Azure AD Connect. Enterprise Mobility & Security: Microsoft Intune, Azure Rights Management, and associated security capabilities. Monitoring & Operations: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and related infrastructure monitoring services. Backup & Disaster Recovery: Azure Site Recovery and Azure Backup. Experience supporting infrastructure implementation, system upgrades, migrations, and technical troubleshooting. Good understanding of enterprise infrastructure security, system availability, performance optimization, and operational best practices. Strong technical documentation and reporting skills. Good written and verbal communication skills in both English and Arabic. Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

b07dd596798a8278.description: About the Role Modern Mills For Food Products Co. is seeking a Manager, Project Management Office for a full-time position in Al Jumum. This role is responsible for the planning, governance, execution, and completion of CAPEX and civil projects. A strong focus will be placed on budgeting, costing, schedule control, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance. The Manager will lead projects involving complex civil engineering works, develop and review CAD drawings, and apply formal PMO governance to ensure consistent and transparent project delivery. The role also ensures that all technical and design aspects of each project comply with Saudi government regulations. Key Responsibilities Develop project charters and plans that define scope, budget, schedule, resources, deliverables, dependencies, and acceptance criteria for CAPEX and operational projects. Establish and manage PMO governance, including stage gates, portfolio prioritization, project controls, dashboards, document control, change control, and escalation routines. Define project goals and KPIs aligned with corporate objectives, evaluate feasibility, conduct cost-benefit analyses, and secure management approvals. Prepare, review, and coordinate CAD drawings, layouts, design packages, specifications, and as-built documentation for civil works. Manage project budgets, optimize resources, and apply cost controls to prevent overruns and identify savings. Develop detailed schedules, monitor progress and critical paths, and adjust resources or recovery plans to address delays. Provide accurate portfolio and project reporting, including forecasts, variance analysis, milestones, risks, issues, and required decisions. Ensure designs and construction comply with project specifications, civil engineering standards, Saudi regulations, permits, and applicable international standards. Establish quality plans, review technical submittals, conduct site inspections, manage non-conformities, and verify completed work against drawings and specifications. Partner with the EHS team to enforce safety requirements and reduce construction and operational risks. Ensure design and construction meet the latest standards required by auditing bodies such as ISO and BRC, and by key customers. Act as the primary contact for project communication, coordinating internal teams, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and regulatory authorities. Select, manage, and evaluate contractors against scope, quality, schedule, safety, and budget commitments. Maintain project risk registers, implement mitigation actions, obtain required permits and approvals, and manage changes through formal governance. Capture lessons learned, standardize project management practices, and implement improvements that reduce cost and cycle time while improving quality and predictability. Engage proactively with partners and vendors to understand each one's role in the overall design and how they interface with each other, bringing all parties together to simplify the design and achieve savings in capital and operating costs. Company Culture and Benefits Modern Mills For Food Products Co. offers a professional environment with a focus on employee development and well-being. The company provides structured training, mentorship, and cross-functional development opportunities to support career growth and learning. Employees contribute to initiatives supporting food security, sustainability, and digital transformation, engaging in meaningful work. The culture is inclusive, fostering collaboration, teamwork, and a positive environment. Compensation includes a competitive salary, comprehensive medical and life insurance, health benefits, and programs designed to support work-life balance. The company also provides access to advanced technology, process automation, and modern operations to drive operational excellence and innovation.

b07e019f5a52a297.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مراق للتجارة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على جمع البيانات المتعلقة بالمنتجات، وبناء علاقات مع العملاء، وإتمام عمليات البيع، ومتابعة التحصيلات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات التفصيلية المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بيانات الاتصال والعناوين. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لتقديم عروض البيع الترويجية واستعراض مواصفات المنتجات وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار المعتمدة ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة. إتمام عمليات البيع، وتحرير الفواتير، وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل يعمل مندوب المبيعات ضمن فريق شركة مراق للتجارة في مدينة مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والقيام بزيارات ميدانية. طبيعة العمل يتضمن الدور مهام متعددة تتطلب التنظيم والمتابعة الدقيقة، بدءاً من جمع المعلومات وصولاً إلى إتمام البيع وتحصيل الديون. يساهم شاغل الوظيفة بشكل مباشر في تحقيق أهداف المبيعات للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

b0a1fc48745b1165.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب عبدالعزيز محمد ابراهيم الوصابي لهندسة المشاريع عن فني مساحة للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة المتنوعة للمشاريع الإنشائية، بما في ذلك المسح الاستطلاعي والتسوية ورسم الخرائط والمخططات المساحية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستكشافية اللازمة لمختلف المشاريع الإنشائية. إعداد مسودات تفصيلية للمنشآت والعوائق والقنوات والطرق الفرعية. تحديد وتثبيت نقاط الاستناد الرئيسة والفرعية ونقاط الربط. اختيار الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية المناسبة لكل مهمة. تنفيذ أعمال التسوية الطولية والعرضية لشبكات البنية التحتية. إجراء أعمال التسوية الشبكية لمشاريع الأبنية والأراضي. تثبيت مواقع وحدود الأبنية من المخططات على أرض الواقع. نقل مواقع وحدود الأبنية القائمة وتثبيتها على المخططات. تثبيت مناسيب جميع الأعمال المتعلقة بالمشروع. تثبيت مسارات الطرق وسكك الحديد وتقاطعاتها. توقيع المنحنيات المختلفة وفقاً للمخططات الهندسية. رسم المقاطع العرضية والطولية والمنحنيات الأفقية والرأسية والمخططات الكنتورية والمساحية المستخدمة في أعمال المساحة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المساحة. القدرة على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستطلاعية والتسوية. مهارة في استخدام الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية. القدرة على قراءة ورسم الخرائط والمخططات المساحية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني المساحة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق المكتب في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور العمل الميداني لتنفيذ المهام المساحية في مواقع المشاريع المختلفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

b0e9f09654438cff.description: About Remedica Remedica is an EU-based pharmaceutical company, established in 1980 and headquartered in Cyprus. The company operates globally, with a presence in over 110 countries. Remedica functions as a trusted generics CDMO and dossier development partner, offering a portfolio of over 300 products across various therapeutic areas, including cardiovascular, oncology, anti-diabetic, anti-infective, central nervous system, alimentary tract, genito-urinary, and musculoskeletal treatments. The company has undergone a significant transformation to become a global player, recognized for its development expertise, EU-based manufacturing capabilities, regulatory knowledge, and strong quality culture. The Role: Key Account Manager GCC Remedica is seeking a Key Account Manager GCC to join its MEA team. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on managing and developing Remedica’s business with assigned distributors and key accounts across the GCC region. The Key Account Manager is responsible for achieving agreed sales, profitability, and collection targets, developing account plans, strengthening customer relationships, coordinating tender participation, and supporting portfolio growth through collaboration with internal functions and local partners. This position is open to Saudi nationals. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary commercial contact for assigned GCC distributors and key accounts, building sustainable relationships and conducting regular business reviews. Develop and implement annual account plans covering sales, profitability, collections, tenders, and portfolio development. Monitor distributor sales, stock levels, and market coverage to identify growth opportunities and performance gaps. Deliver agreed sales, gross profit, and collection targets for assigned accounts and markets. Identify opportunities for portfolio expansion, new product introductions, and business development with public and private sector accounts. Support negotiations on pricing, payment terms, and other commercial conditions within approved authority limits. Identify and track tender opportunities, coordinating tender assessment, preparation, and timely submission. Prepare and maintain sales forecasts, demand plans, monthly shipment plans, and collection projections. Monitor orders through the ERP system and coordinate with Order Execution and Supply Chain for timely delivery. Monitor receivables, overdue balances, and payment commitments in coordination with Finance. Prepare accurate performance reports, account reviews, forecasts, and market updates. Maintain complete customer records, commercial agreements, and account documentation. Qualifications and Experience Experience required: 5-10 years in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to manage key accounts and distributor relationships. Proven track record of achieving sales, profitability, and collection targets. Strong understanding of market trends, competitor activity, and customer requirements in the GCC region. Ability to coordinate tender processes and institutional business. Proficiency in financial management and reporting related to sales and collections. Compensation and Benefits Remedica offers a competitive compensation package, including 14 salaries, a provident fund, and additional benefits. The salary for this position is not disclosed. Equal Opportunity Statement Remedica is committed to equal pay for equal work and work of equal value. Roles are evaluated using a structured, gender-neutral job evaluation framework that assesses knowledge, skills, responsibilities, effort, and working conditions. Applications from all qualified candidates are welcomed, regardless of sex, race, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, sexual orientation, gender identity, or age.

b09a1314c9b20e9c.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a BIM Engineer to join the site-based Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC) team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the implementation, coordination, and management of Building Information Modeling (BIM) processes throughout the construction phase of a major landmark development project. The successful candidate will ensure alignment with project requirements, digital delivery standards, and client objectives. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation and execution of BIM requirements across construction activities. Review and validate BIM models for compliance with project standards, BIM Execution Plans (BEP), and employer requirements. Coordinate multidisciplinary models and assist in identifying, tracking, and resolving clashes and design conflicts. Review contractor BIM deliverables, including models, shop drawings, and digital submissions. Monitor model quality, data integrity, and compliance with project BIM protocols. Perform model audits and support the management of a Common Data Environment (CDE). Coordinate with contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of BIM outputs. Support construction planning, sequencing, quantity verification, and visualization using BIM tools. Generate BIM reports, model reviews, coordination records, and project dashboards. Assist with as-built model development, testing, commissioning, and digital handover requirements. Ensure BIM-related deliverables support project quality, scheduling, and asset information requirements. Support the Resident Engineer and Construction Manager in achieving project objectives through effective digital delivery. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architectural Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. Minimum of 10+ years of BIM experience on major building, infrastructure, or mixed-use development projects. Proficiency in Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, and BIM 360/Autodesk Construction Cloud. Experience in BIM coordination, clash detection, model review, and multidisciplinary integration. Strong understanding of ISO 19650 standards and BIM execution processes. Experience reviewing contractor BIM submissions and digital deliverables. Strong communication, stakeholder coordination, and reporting skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Desired Skills Previous experience within a Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC), PMC, or engineering consultancy environment. Experience on mega projects, hospitality developments, airports, convention centers, or large mixed-use developments. Knowledge of 4D construction sequencing and 5D quantity/cost integration. Experience managing Common Data Environments (CDE) and digital document control systems. Familiarity with asset information models, digital handover, and facilities management integration. Professional BIM certifications from Autodesk, BRE Academy, or equivalent institutions. Strong organizational skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced project environment. Work Environment This position is a full-time role based on-site in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, as part of a Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC) team for a major landmark development project.

b02cc1c87e70a267.job_title: Real Estate Business Development Section Head
b02cc1c87e70a267.description: About Masan Properties Masan Properties is a design-driven property developer based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The company focuses on creating refined and enduring living spaces, with a portfolio that includes residential and hospitality properties. Masan emphasizes architecture, interior design, and harmony with the surrounding environment, collaborating with selected architects and designers who value proportion, material quality, and the details of everyday living. The Role: Design & Project Manager, Real Estate Development Masan Properties is seeking a Design & Project Manager – Real Estate Development for a full-time, on-site position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves overseeing residential and hospitality projects from early planning and design stages through construction and handover. The manager will lead an existing in-house technical and site team and work closely with external consultants and contractors. Key Responsibilities Developing project briefs. Managing the design process. Reviewing drawings and material selections. Ensuring designs meet project requirements, budgets, and Masan’s quality standards. Overseeing project schedules. Overseeing consultant and contractor performance. Overseeing authority approvals. Overseeing tendering processes. Overseeing construction progress. Ensuring issues are resolved and projects are delivered successfully. Candidate Requirements The ideal candidate will possess a combination of strong design judgment, practical construction knowledge, and an understanding of the commercial considerations inherent in real estate development.

b06328db424471f9.description: عامل خدمات مساندة مهنته الأساسية تحميل وتنزيل بالاضافة إلى متابعة اعمال التحميل والتنزيل لدى المستأجرين والتأكد من كونهم ملتزمين بالاشتراطات وتوجييههم باتباع السياسات والاجراءات المتبعة والبلاغ عن المخالفات الحاصلة.

b0ab632196cf877a.description: About the Role Canonical is seeking a Manager People Analytics to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is situated within the Workplace Engineering function, which operates at the intersection of HR analytics and Product Engineering. The position reports directly to the Global Head of Workplace Engineering, within the Data discipline of the People department. Role Context and Purpose The Workplace Engineering function transforms workforce data into "People Products" designed to enhance performance. This role moves beyond traditional reporting to engineer tools and insights that influence future outcomes. Experienced data professionals at Canonical integrate software, data, and business objectives to transform analytical artifacts into strategic assets, elevating decision-making and innovation across global operations, including sales, marketing, engineering, and human resources. They balance technical precision with business pragmatism, developing experiments, automations, and products that convert insights into tangible outcomes. The role also contributes to shaping the future of the AI/Data stack in open source. Key Responsibilities Lead and mentor a specialized squad comprising People Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and UX Designers, functioning as a product squad leader. Serve as Product Owner for People Science initiatives, translating human behavioral intent for engineering teams. Develop strategic insights and drive business outcomes by moving beyond descriptive metrics to predictive and prescriptive analytics, such as forecasting attrition risk based on engagement data. Act as a "Translator-in-Chief," converting complex data models into clear narratives and leading the development of AI Agents for real-time insight delivery to managers. Ensure the People Data Stack is secure, compliant with GDPR and privacy regulations, and serves as a single source of truth for all People-related offerings. Identify opportunities to integrate high-tech solutions into People offerings to optimize human involvement and maximize value. Required Qualifications and Skills A background in data science, mathematics, or engineering, with proficiency in advanced statistics, data wrangling/science, databases (SQL), or software engineering. Strong skills in coding/scripting languages (Python, R, JavaScript), software engineering, data visualization (*, Superset, Tableau), and automation. Ability to translate business questions into key research objectives and identify appropriate methodologies for execution, synthesis, and analysis of findings. Proven ability to lead and guide teams to execute against planned roadmaps, demonstrating a strong mentor/coaching mindset. Willingness to challenge the status quo and maintain resilience in the face of challenges. Ambition to contribute to the development of tomorrow's AI/Data stack in open source. An exceptional academic record from high school and university. Business-level written and spoken English. Sincere personal motivation aligned with Canonical's mission. Availability for international travel 2-4 times a year for company events, each up to two weeks long. Experience required: 5-10 years. About Canonical Canonical is a technology firm recognized for its contributions to open source. Its platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. The company serves leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across various sectors. Canonical is founder-led, profitable, and expanding. Operating with a globally distributed collaboration model since 2004, Canonical maintains no central headquarters, with most colleagues working remotely. The company emphasizes high expectations and a commitment to excellence, fostering an environment that encourages continuous learning and development. Equal Opportunity Employer Canonical is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a workplace free from discrimination. The company values diversity of experience, perspectives, and background, recognizing their contribution to a better work environment and improved products. All applications receive fair consideration regardless of identity.

b0c3950b734305d6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قرطاس الخليج لصناعة الورق عن مهندس كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير عمليات التصنيع الكيميائي، وإعداد برامج التشغيل والصيانة لوحدات الإنتاج، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة عمليات التصنيع الكيميائي المختلفة، مثل البلمرة، الهدرجة، الأكسدة، البلورة، التبخير، والتقطير. متابعة الظروف التشغيلية لوحدات الإنتاج، بما في ذلك الضغط ودرجة الحرارة والتدفق. تحديد وتطبيق الطرق الفعالة لتطوير عمليات الإنتاج وتحسين جودة المنتج النهائي. إعداد برامج تشغيل وحدات تصنيع المنتجات الكيميائية، ووضع خطط العمل التنفيذية ومتابعة تنفيذها. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية لوحدات وتجهيزات التصنيع الكيميائي وفقاً لتعليمات الشركة المصنعة ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكيميائية. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق مبادئ عمليات التصنيع الكيميائي. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد فرص التحسين وحل المشكلات التشغيلية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكيميائي ضمن فريق متخصص في منشآت شركة قرطاس الخليج لصناعة الورق بالدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على الابتكار والتحسين المستمر لعمليات الإنتاج. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الكيميائيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

b074cad9bebf03fb.description: About Alnafitha IT Alnafitha IT, established in 1993, is a leading independent provider of IT services and solutions in Saudi Arabia. With over 30 years of experience, Alnafitha IT has completed more than 4,000 projects, served over 3,000 customers, and collaborated with over 65 partners in Riyadh. Assist in updating the sales pipeline and maintaining accurate records within the CRM system. Help follow up on marketing campaigns and events to engage prospective clients. Assist in scheduling meetings, demos, and sales calls. Participate in client conversations and note key requirements for follow-up by senior sales staff. Help maintain communication with clients throughout the sales process under supervision. Assist in preparing proposals and quotes with input from senior team members. Support document collection and submission for RFPs, contracts, and client onboarding. Ensure that client documents and sales materials are updated and organized. Coordinate internally with marketing, technical, and sales teams to ensure alignment during the sales cycle. Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and product knowledge updates. Maintain basic CRM hygiene, including client data, opportunity status, and meeting logs. Provide weekly summaries of assigned leads and prospects. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in business administration, IT, or a related field. 0-1 years of relevant experience. The company focuses on optimizing operational efficiency and effective resource utilization to enhance customer satisfaction and profitability. Alnafitha IT believes in empowering its employees and nurturing their growth to drive leadership in technology and customer satisfaction.

b05a37b17cc400ad.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جست كلين للتجارة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى دعم نجاح الشركاء التشغيليين وضمان تقديم أفضل تجربة لهم، بالإضافة إلى المساهمة في تنمية الأعمال من خلال إدارة علاقات العملاء وتعزيز فرص المبيعات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة ويعتبر وظيفة بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وإدارة قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، وتحديث بيانات الاتصال والعناوين بشكل دوري. التواصل مع العملاء الحاليين والمحتملين من خلال الزيارات الميدانية أو وسائل الاتصال المختلفة للترويج للخدمات والمنتجات. تقديم العروض التجارية وشرح مزايا الخدمات والميزات التنافسية بما يساهم في تحقيق الأهداف البيعية. التفاوض على الأسعار وتقديم الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المعتمدة لإتمام عمليات البيع. متابعة دورة البيع كاملة بدءًا من استقطاب العميل وحتى إتمام التعاقد أو البيع وتوثيق العمليات ذات العلاقة. تحصيل مستحقات العملاء ومتابعة الديون المستحقة والتنسيق مع الإدارة المالية لضمان السداد في الوقت المحدد. إعداد تقارير دورية عن نشاط المبيعات، الفرص التجارية، وحالة العملاء ومشاركتها مع الإدارة. بناء علاقات طويلة الأمد مع العملاء والشركاء بما يدعم النمو واستمرارية الأعمال. دعم العمليات التشغيلية يتولى مندوب المبيعات مسؤولية متابعة الأداء اليومي وحل المشكلات التشغيلية التي قد تواجه الشركاء. يشمل ذلك التنسيق الفعال مع الفرق الداخلية المختلفة لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة عالية وتحقيق أهداف الخدمة المحددة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على بناء وإدارة علاقات قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وتفاوض ممتازة. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتنمية الأعمال. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في جست كلين للتجارة.

b06862dca3590294.description: About the Role MSI Qatar is seeking a Business Development Manager to support the continued growth of an established B2B communications and services business in Saudi Arabia. b09db7285d5ff70c.description: About the Role The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) is seeking a Refund Lead Auditor to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is for an experienced professional capable of conducting work with general directions, focusing on developing solutions to challenges requiring analysis and addressing escalated issues. The position involves complex operational activities, including researching industries for revenue benchmarking and developing audit reports within established policies and procedures. Refund Planning Responsibilities Review and study refund policies to stay current on refund limit utilization, risk control authorizations, and applicable margins, ensuring adherence to ZATCA’s rules, regulations, policies, and procedures. Develop and update assessment templates and audit tools in accordance with operational procedures and policies to facilitate customer request analysis and timely evaluation. Keep abreast of the latest developments, news, and updates by industry type and sector (*, business and insurance, telecommunication, consumer goods) to incorporate new tax practices adopted by taxpayers and businesses into assessments and audit reviews. Maintain and update refund manuals, eligibility criteria, legal requirements, and supporting documents by taxpayer type, integrating them into computer-aided audit tools to facilitate audit assessment and review. Refund Operations and Case Management Consolidate, categorize, and prioritize refund requests and schedules, sorting them by tax/industry type and ensuring dispatch to relevant audit teams for assessment and review. Review refund applications and requests, examine the validity of legal documents presented by taxpayers, and ensure completeness of supporting documents prior to case assessment and evaluation. Gather necessary data for desk audits, communicate with relevant stakeholders (account managers, taxpayers, banks, audit bureau, government entities) to obtain information and clarifications, and consult with the legal function for contractual structures to safeguard applicant legitimacy. Research public news, articles, databases, and shared channels to investigate and understand taxpayers’ business activity, including structure, size, process, and jurisdictions. Study and assess taxpayers’ financial status, income statements, financial strength and capabilities, and revenue streams to compare with benchmarks and similar industries, deciding on the appropriate assessment approach (actual, estimated, reduced assessments). Inspect and investigate taxpayers’ declarations, pinpoint high-risk and speculative issues, detect non-compliant cases, and communicate with internal stakeholders to avoid potential risks, including tax evasion. Consolidate legal and financial observations, study, and evaluate them against pre-approved eligibility criteria and refund requirements to recommend approval/rejection decisions in line with applicable policies and procedures. Manage the development of audit reports, including tax assessments (actual/reduced/estimated assessments), to identify taxpayers’ refund amounts. Develop lists of compliant taxpayers with accepted refunds and related amounts, submitting them to internal committees to secure necessary approvals for payment release/transfer. Monitor taxpayer objections and appeals, ensuring coordination with Legal Affairs or AMANA to resolve disputes and support key testimonies by providing clarifications on final audit findings and results. Maintain and update refund operations-related systems and databases, ensuring all audit findings are administered and stored securely to facilitate data exchange with internal stakeholders and other government agencies. Reporting and Support Draft refund audit reports to highlight recommendations and conclusions along with relevant evidence, proofs, and supporting documents, escalating them for revision and verification. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. This role requires professionals capable of conducting work with general directions and developing solutions to complex challenges. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

b0b95f4a46dae459.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، تقدير المواد اللازمة، متابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وسلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية لمختلف أنواع المنشآت (المنزلية، الصناعية، والتجارية) ومكوناتها. تقدير الكميات المطلوبة من المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، والإشراف على تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية، الاستمرارية، والتأريض. تشخيص الأعطال في التمديدات الكهربائية، وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. معرفة قوية بمخططات التمديدات الكهربائية المنزلية والصناعية والتجارية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد حلولها. الالتزام بتطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. مكان العمل ونوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في تبوك. سيعمل الفني الكهربائي ضمن فريق مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات، وستكون مسؤولياته محورية لضمان جودة وسلامة المشاريع الكهربائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في تبوك.

b0c35a400f2e305d.description: About Adobe Adobe focuses on transforming the world through digital experiences, enabling individuals and global brands to design and deliver exceptional digital interactions. b08d8fedd88e3697.description: About the Role AWN ENTERPRISES is seeking a Food Cost Controller to join our team in Al Khobar. b0b9b7053efb2f6b.description: Who Are We❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also, Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners. The Job in a Nutshell💡 You will construct agentic AI architecture, leveraging large language models to orchestrate planning, execution, and tool interactions with minimal supervision. Working within a compact engineering team, you will build the core foundational infrastructure, spanning microservices, integration protocols, state management, tracing, and eval harnesses, ensuring systems are production-ready, reliable, and scalable. This hands-on backend software engineering position focuses primarily on coding, testing, and system diagnostics. While prompt design is incorporated into the workflow, complex architectural challenges reside within the underlying infrastructure. We welcome applicants across diverse seniority levels. Given that production-grade agentic engineering remains an emerging discipline, candidates bring varied expertise; candidate capability determines final level placement. Opportunities exist for early-career developers through veteran software architects. Engineering excellence remains mandatory across all levels. Junior engineers pair directly with senior mentors to own production components within three months, while senior engineers drive technical standards and architectural vision. What You Will Do ❓ Architect and maintain agent infrastructure, including orchestration logic, session handling, state management, and reliable backend service interfaces. Design robust tool integrations and MCP servers featuring precise boundary definitions and comprehensive error recovery handlers. Implement end-to-end tracing and observability for model calls, retrieval, and tool executions adhering to OpenTelemetry GenAI standards. Construct evaluation suites, benchmarks, and regression tests to validate model iterations and systematically capture production edge cases. Perform deep-dive root cause analysis on runtime failures, loops, context degradation, or hallucinated outputs to strengthen system resiliency. Enforce runtime guardrails, cost thresholds, RBAC permissions, output validation schemas, and human-in-the-loop validation triggers. Monitor industry advancements, emerging AI research, and architectural patterns, sharing technical insights across the engineering organization. What Are We Looking For❓ Essential Deep software engineering expertise in a modern programming language, prioritizing algorithmic depth over superficial multi-language breadth. Strong computer science foundations in data structures, algorithms, memory allocation, and concurrent execution patterns. Practical experience with backend infrastructure: REST/gRPC APIs, relational/non-relational databases, caching tiers, message queues, and distributed systems resilience. Proficiency with Git, automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and writing clean, maintainable software. Comprehensive mental model of LLM mechanics: context window constraints, tokenization, function calling protocols, non-deterministic behaviors, and hallucination management. Demonstrated history of delivering full-lifecycle technical projects across production environments, academic work, open source, or side initiatives. Methodical debugging skills with the ability to articulate systematic troubleshooting methodologies. Strong technical documentation and written communication skills to articulate complex distributed system behaviors. Expectations by Seniority Level Core requirements apply universally, with ownership and operational scale adjusting based on candidate seniority. Early Career: Focuses on technical foundations, algorithmic problem-solving, and curiosity. Prior agentic experience is not required; mentorship is provided to expand scope over well-defined modules. Mid-Level: Owns sub-systems end-to-end, translates ambiguous requirements into robust architecture, and demonstrates a proven track record of shipping and maintaining production services. Senior Level: Drives strategic architectural direction, possesses hands-on experience scaling non-deterministic systems, elevates team-wide engineering practices, and actively challenges technical assumptions. Nice to Have Hands-on experience developing application prototypes integrated with LLM APIs. Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or custom tool integrations. Understanding of vector database indexing, embedding generation, and retrieval pipelines (RAG). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), telemetry, or IaC tooling. Knowledge of GenAI security paradigms, prompt injection mitigation, and threat modeling. Active open-source contributions or community engagement. Out of Scope Extensive experience with specific agent frameworks, given the nascent nature of the ecosystem. Academic AI research background, specialized ML degrees, or mathematical derivation of backpropagation. Deep expertise in base model training or fine-tuning workflows. Flawless portfolio presentations; emphasis is placed on technical depth and problem-solving reasoning. Strictly conventional career trajectories; non-traditional and self-taught engineering backgrounds are evaluated equally. Technical Standards & Architecture Our engineering environment adheres to industry standards and operational frameworks, with continuous learning embedded into the engineering onboarding process. Model Context Protocol (MCP): Open standard managed via the Linux Foundation for integrating models with tool services and data stores. OpenTelemetry GenAI Conventions: Standardized instrumentation schemas for tracking model execution traces, step transitions, and tool invocations. OWASP GenAI & Agentic Security Guidelines: Threat modeling standards emphasizing containment strategies, least-privilege tooling, strict input sanitization, and authorization gates for critical actions. Eval-Driven Development: Mandatory evaluation validation prior to shipping behavioral changes, relying on internal domain-specific test harnesses rather than external benchmark metrics. What We Offer You❗ We believe you will love working at Foodics! We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in-office, and hybrid work setups. We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares. We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment. Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry. We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.
